name: HASEKO
business_summary: HASEKO Corporation engages in the real estate, construction, and management and operation businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Construction related business, Real Estate-related Segment, Management and operation business, and overseas segment. It offers construction services for condominiums, including planning, design, construction, and sales. The company is also involved in the real estate development; real estate brokerage; construction and sale of real estate properties; large scale repair work, interior remodeling, and condominium rehabilitation; and consignment sale and real estate brokerage of for-sale condominiums. In addition, it manages facilities for the elderly; leases office equipment; provides insurance agency, printing, OA equipment rental, human resource placement, and web marketing services in support of corporate activities. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
